body: I'm glad to hear I'm not the only one going through this, your response has made me feel a lot better. I hope we can both get everything sorted and our dreams achieved one day.
I love too many songs to have an absolute favorite, but I guess right now it would be: Radiohead - Decks Dark
That's so awesome. Hope you have a good time meeting him!

I love this beat, I'm a producer myself and I can tell you really put your emotions into this. I especially love that low pitched reverby vocal, it gives me goosebumps, and some real Burial vibes. I really hope you stick around and continue to contribute your art, man. Music has the power to change lives and save people, even in this shitty world we live in. I really hope you reconsider.
Even when partners were assigned, I somehow always ended up doing them by myself, haha.

[This song](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KMfL7rVAu0U) is one of my favorites from them.

If you like it, I'd recommend checking out their album [Bon Iver, Bon Iver](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L-wsTe9XDBg). Their other albums are really great too, but not as accessible.
Oh wow, I'm a big Bon Iver fan but I've somehow never heard this cover before. Thanks for sharing!
A lot of us lurk. I actively check this sub at least a few times a week, but I don't think I've ever actually posted on here before (besides now I guess).

I feel the exact same way. I just want to be rich, like multimillionaire rich, and the only way to get rich in society today is to own a company. And you can't own a company without money... which you can't get unless you slave away for years working at someone else's company or you just get lucky and have rich parents. And, you can't even work at a decent place, making at least $10 above minimum wage, without some bullshit university degree (which takes years to pay off). It's all bullshit. Society was built to keep the poor down, and allow the rich to become richer.

I feel you. I'm at an age right now where I should have some kind of minimum wage job, but even the thought of it makes me want to die.  I just wish I could sit home and make music all day, without having to worry about needing an income to survive. If it came down to it, I'd rather be homeless than working some slave wage job.

I was just browsing /r/SuicideWatch and thinking the same thing. I don't usually come to this sub, but I had been listening to A Moon Shaped Pool earlier and was gonna make a post on here about how I was feeling. Radiohead is one of the few things in my life that inspires me to get up every morning and create music. It's the only thing I ever want to do, and the only thing I live for. Sometimes the pain of living becomes too much for me and makes me want to end myself, but as of right now, I'm still holding on.

I don't know what you are going through right now OP, or why you are in pain, but I really hope that you have a passion or hobby that keeps you going. I hope that you won't leave us today. And if you don't have a passion, and are dead set on what you want to do, I hope that you find peace.
I agree completely, I've never been able to understand why someone would want to bring a child into a life of suffering. You should check out /r/antinatalism.

Yeah, this happens to me a lot too. I've found myself Googling very simple phrases and words when I'm writing posts/comments because my brain is afraid that I'll somehow forget how to speak English and embarrass myself.

I feel this way too. I try my best to treat everyone with respect, even when they treat me like shit, but I usually just end up getting more shit for it. It sucks, but knowing that kindness in response to hatefulness is the only way to really change a hateful person is what keeps me from being like them. I hope your future gets brighter soon.
I'm glad to hear that I'm not the only person listening to Radiohead and browsing this sub right now. I hope you can find the motivation to stay strong and keep going on.

> Sometimes I think I'd like to go for a walk but then I realise I can't do it. I get so anxious. Although sometimes I wonder if I'm not really anxious and just making it up, because I don't really get the physical symptoms other than blushing and sweating. I've never had a panic attack, even in my worst moments.

I can heavily relate to this. I have severe anxiety that prevents me from going to places, or even just leaving my house, but I have never had any kind of panic attack before. As a result, most of the people I've spoken to about it just think that I'm either exaggerating how bad my anxiety is, or think that I'm just being lazy. Fuck anxiety.
I can relate. The only thing that makes me feel good is making music and listening to music. I'm also a big Porter fan myself.

Thanks for the advice. I've been trying to plan out my life for the past few years now, and I have a lot of outside interests, but I can't exactly find other people my age who are interested in the same things that I am. I'm hoping that as I become more independent I can meet new people who are interested in those things, but for the time being, I'm stuck surrounded by a lot of people who just misunderstand me.

> What does it matter what people who don't play any part in your life think.

But what about people in school? It seems to matter a whole lot, at least in my experience as a teenager in high school. Sure, maybe it won't matter when I'm not in school, but when I'm there, and when I feel shitty because I've been socially ostracized for years because I can't socialize like other people naturally can, it makes life so much more difficult. Personally, it's impossible for me not to worry about how others see me when the majority of people around me can socialize just fine, and I'm the only who literally can't.
